answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The meadow multiplier is published, charged in violet, and hollow lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 11 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 1620 identities would post 3444 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
